sources.author: Matt Shumer
sources.title: How to Run a Gauntlet Loop
verified_sections: The whole idea: builder and fresh-context critic compare an inspectable artifact to a reference.
Never let the builder grade itself: give the reviewer the goal, criteria and actual artifact, without builder history.
Let it keep going: original is open-ended; quality, diminishing returns and compute budget are operator stop conditions.
sources.short_direct_excerpt: You can stop when you like the result, when improvements become too small to matter,
sources.project_difference: The three-round cap is explicitly our project adaptation.

sources.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
sources.verified_claim: External tool feedback supports validation and revision; no assertion that cross-vendor critics guarantee correctness.

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.verified_claim: One model can provide generation, feedback and refinement; our separate-family rule is an additional engineering precaution.
